map.税后等效收益率计算器，输入免税品种收益率与边际税率求税后等效应税收益率，辅助固收: The After-Tax Equivalent Yield Calculator takes the yield of a tax-free instrument and the marginal tax rate to find the equivalent taxable yield, helping compare fixed-income products.
map.TEY=免税收益率÷(1−边际税率)。只有应税品种收益率高于 TEY 时才更划算: TEY = tax-free yield ÷ (1 − marginal tax rate). Only a taxable instrument yielding more than TEY is better, so plug in your own marginal rate for comparison; capital gains tax is not included.
map.比较免税（如国债利息）与应税固收品种的真实回报。: Compare the real return of tax-free instruments (such as government bond interest) with taxable fixed-income holdings.
map.在高税率下判断免税品种是否更优。: Judging whether a tax-free instrument is better at high tax rates.
map.做固收组合的品种比价。: For relative valuation across fixed-income holdings.
map.免税品种收益率 3%、边际税率 20% 的等效应税收益率: Taxable equivalent yield for a 3% tax-free yield at a 20% marginal tax rate
map.：TEY=免税收益率÷(1−税率)=3%÷0.8=3.75%。即该免税品种相当于: : TEY = tax-free yield ÷ (1 − tax rate) = 3% ÷ 0.8 = 3.75%. This tax-free instrument is equivalent to a taxable one yielding 3.75% before tax, so only a taxable instrument yielding more than 3.75% is better.

map.不一定。低税率时 TEY 提升有限，若应税品种票面远高于免税品种仍可能更优。应代: Not necessarily. At low tax rates the TEY gain is small, and a taxable instrument with a much higher quoted yield can still win. Plug in your own marginal rate to compare.
map.TEY 通常只处理「利息税」口径。若涉及买卖价差资本利得税，需另行折算，模型会更: TEY normally covers interest tax only. If capital gains tax on trading spreads is involved, a separate adjustment is needed and the model becomes more complex.
